metadata.description: The Tripura government has reportedly completed the settlement process for the last batch of Mizoram Bru refugees, as per a quadripartite agreement initiated by the Home Ministry on January 16, 2020. The agreement aimed to permanently settle 6,959 Bru tribe families, totalling 37,136 individuals, in 12 different locations across four districts in Tripura. However, a special report suggests that the ground situation may differ from official statements. The 12th settlement colony, Laugangsom, established in the Santirbazar subdivision, is said to accommodate 633 Bru families over 30 hectares of previously unused land. Main Bhi Bharat team visited this place in the South Tripura district to know the truth of the claims of the administration. Please watch this special report
